messages:
ben-platform: RFC kick-off: prefer-low-latency fallback policy. Try local region first; if p95 > 180ms for >5s switch to a fallback region with lower p95. Need agreement on header contract + minimal telemetry fields. Thoughts?

sara: Quick q — how do we pick fallback region? last-1m p95? also what about quota/billing attribution when we fail over?

anil: Selection idea: use rolling 30s p50/p95, pick lowest p95 among top-3 topology-adjacent regions. Emit a compact decision header: `X-RW-Route-Decision: local->fallback;to=eu-west-1;reason=latency;p95=172`

ben-platform: Header format looks good. Also we should avoid immediate flip-flopping — propose sticky_ttl_s = 45 for session_id pinning. Open to lower if perf team says 30 is better.

maria-ux: Console needs: small badge for "active-region" in route list, a micro-sparkline for failover count, and a per-project toggle to opt out of auto-fallback. Also surface the last fallback reason on the route detail.

anil: Caveat: cross-region fallback may cold-start KV/model shard caches. Prefer fallback regions in same replication group or with replicated caches, otherwise short-term latency wins could vanish.

ben-platform: Agreed. Add `cache_affinity_ok:true|false` in decision telemetry and record `fallback_latency_ms`, `cache_warm_estimate`.

sara: Draft policy proto (pseudo-config):

```
route_policy {
  name: "prefer-low-latency"
  probe_threshold {
    p95_ms: 180
    window_s: 5
  }
  fallback_selection: "lowest_p95_within_topology_radius"
  sticky_ttl_s: 45
  prefer_cache_affinity: true
  emit_headers: ["X-RW-Route-Decision","X-RW-Active-Region"]
}
```

anil: Telemetry/event keys: `route_decision`, `origin`, `selected`, `reason`, `p95_ms`, `cache_affinity_ok`, `sticky_ttl_s`, `route_tag`. Keep names short to limit header and event size.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing/policies prefer-low-latency v1 -> staging at 2159994510 :rocket:

anil: Billing note: provide config `pin_billing_to_home_region` default=true. If true, attribute tenant usage to their home region ledger even when served elsewhere. If false, attribute to served region. This avoids surprise bills for customers who expect regional pricing.

maria-ux: For manual overrides: default off. If support/project enables manual region, emit `manual_region_override` audit event with `reason` and `actor` fields so we can trace.

ben-platform: Action items: anil to finalize header + telemetry names (PR), sara to write docs on quota attribution & sticky TTL rationale, maria to mock the console panels and override toggle. I'll write the RFC + rollout plan tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
